title: LP Building Solutions Expands Design Options with New LP® SmartSide® Primed 8” Brushed Smooth Shake Lap Siding
summary: LP Building Solutions introduces new LP® SmartSide® Primed 8” Brushed Smooth Shake Lap Siding, giving homeowners and builders more design flexibility with a premium shake-inspired aesthetic and durable engineered wood performance.
body_markdown:
**NASHVILLE, Tenn. (Sept. 8, 2026)** –[LP Building Solutions](https://www.lpcorp.com/) (LP), a leading manufacturer of high-performance building products, today announced the expansion of its LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding portfolio with the introduction of the new LP® SmartSide® Primed 8” Brushed Smooth Shake Lap Siding, designed to give homeowners and building professionals greater flexibility in achieving refined, traditional exterior designs.


Demand for shake-style accents remains strong across many housing markets, particularly for gables and architectural focal points. The new profile addresses that trend with a smaller reveal that creates a more detailed appearance than larger-format shake products.


The LP® SmartSide® 8” Brushed Smooth Shake Lap Siding is available primed, features a customizable 5-inch to 6-inch reveal, and measures 8 inches wide by 4 feet long. Its reversible design allows installation with either a straight or staggered edge, giving builders and homeowners additional design flexibility.


The new offering complements existing LP SmartSide 12-inch shake products, which support larger 7-inch to 10-inch reveals. Together, the expanded portfolio allows builders and homeowners to select the profile that best matches their architectural vision.


“Many homeowners are drawn to the character and craftsmanship that a smaller shake reveal can create,” said LP Director of Product Management and Innovation Sarah Caperton. “The LP SmartSide 8” Brushed Smooth Shake gives builders and homeowners another option to achieve that look while delivering the durability and performance they expect from LP SmartSide products.”


The new shake profile is engineered for long-lasting performance and is backed by LP’s 5/50-year limited warranty, providing added peace of mind for builders and homeowners. Refer to the limited warranty at[LPCorp.com/literature](https://www.lpcorp.com/product-literature) for complete details, including important limitations and exclusions.


To learn more about LP SmartSide shake lap products, visit[LPCorp.com](https://www.lpcorp.com/products/siding-trim/shakes) .


**About LP Building Solutions**


As a leader in high-performance building solutions, Louisiana-Pacific Corporation (LP Building Solutions, NYSE: LPX) manufactures engineered wood products that meet the demands of builders, remodelers, and homeowners worldwide. LP’s extensive portfolio of innovative and dependable products includes siding (LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding, LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Trim & Siding, LP BuilderSeries® Lap Siding, and LP® Outdoor Building Solutions®), LP® Structural Solutions (LP® FlameBlock® Fire-Rated Sheathing, LP BurnGuard®\[BB6.1\] FRT OSB, LP WeatherLogic® Air & Water Barrier, LP® TechShield® Radiant Barrier Sheathing, LP Legacy® Premium Sub-Flooring, and LP® TopNotch® 350 Durable Sub-Flooring), and LP® Oriented Strand Board. In addition to product solutions, LP provides industry-leading customer service and warranties. Since its founding in 1972, LP has been Building a Better World™ by helping customers construct beautiful, durable homes while shareholders build lasting value. Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, LP operates more than 20 manufacturing facilities across North and South America. For more information, visit[LPCorp.com](https://www.lpcorp.com/) .
